notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

checkout.title: Complete your payment with confidence
checkout.description: Enter your card and billing details below. Axipays validates your payment data in real time, protects sensitive fields, and guides you through the redirect flow securely.

preview.backNote: Your CVV remains masked and is only used for secure payment authorization.

cardHolderName.label: Card Holder Name
cardHolderName.placeholder: Enter the name on the card
cardHolderName.hint: Use the exact name printed on the payment card.

email.label: Email Address
email.hint: We use this email to build the secure request signature.

cardNumber.label: Card Number
cardNumber.hint: Your card number is masked on screen and validated with the Luhn check.

cvv.label: CVV / CVC
cvv.hint: This value is never displayed after submission.

address.label: Address
address.hint: Billing address information improves payment verification.

phone.label: Phone
phone.hint: Use international format with country code.

errors.redirectMissing: The payment redirect URL was not returned by the server.
errors.redirectStatusFailed: The redirect status could not be fetched.

validation.cardHolderNameMin: Card holder name must be at least 3 characters.
validation.expiryMonthInvalid: Expiry month must be between 01 and 12.
validation.expiryYearPast: Expiry year must be the current year or later.
validation.amountFormat: Amount must be a valid number with up to 2 decimals.
validation.amountPositive: Amount must be greater than zero.
validation.addressRequired: Address must be at least 8 characters.
validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid international phone number.

summary.amountDescription: The summary updates live as the form changes so users can confirm values before redirecting.
summary.securityOne: Card data is validated in the browser before the API request is sent.
summary.securityTwo: Sensitive values are never logged and CVV remains masked on every screen.
summary.securityThree: The checkout store is cleared after a successful payment initiation.

iframe.title: Redirect Experience
iframe.description: The payment redirect is shown here in an iframe and also opened in a new browser tab.

statusPanel.title: Payment Lifecycle
statusPanel.description: Track the current submission state and review whether the redirect flow is active.
statusPanel.awaitingSubmission: No payment has been initiated yet. Submit the form to generate the secure Axipays redirect flow.
statusPanel.redirectActive: The redirect URL is active below. A new browser tab was opened alongside the embedded iframe.

help.title: What happens next
help.lineOne: After submission, Axipays generates the HMAC hash, sends the initiation request, and opens the redirect URL in parallel surfaces.
help.lineTwo: The payment status modal updates immediately when a status is returned directly or inferred from the redirect lifecycle.
help.lineThree: If the provider sends a pending state first, the checkout keeps monitoring for a later success or failure signal.

success.title: Payment successful
success.description: The payment completed successfully and the customer can safely continue.

failed.title: Payment failed
failed.description: The payment could not be completed. Review the response and try again if needed.

pending.title: Payment pending
pending.description: The payment is still being processed. Keep the redirect open while the final status resolves.

dashboard.title: Monitor payment performance in real time
dashboard.description: Track transaction outcomes, compare currency mix, and inspect detailed payment history with export-ready operational reporting.

charts.statusBreakdownDescription: Live count split across successful, failed, and pending payments.
charts.volumeOverTimeDescription: Daily payment volume aggregated from transaction history.
charts.currencyDistributionDescription: See how traffic is distributed across supported currencies.

table.title: Transaction history
table.description: Search, sort, paginate, export, and inspect the latest transaction rows.

states.emptyDescription: Transactions will appear here once payment activity is available.

toasts.copySuccessDescription: The order ID is now on your clipboard.
toasts.copyErrorDescription: We could not copy the order ID. Please try again.
toasts.exportSuccessDescription: The filtered transactions were exported successfully.
